title: Trapped! Escape Room

services.name: Escape Rooms
services.desc: Yes. Every Trapped! Las Vegas booking is private, so your reservation is exclusively for your group and you will not be combined with strangers. Choose from five immersive Las Vegas escape games at our location less than a mile from the Las Vegas Strip. Whether you are planning a date night, family outing, birthday, team event, or first escape-room experience, you can focus on the story and puzzles with the people you came with. A private escape room reserves the full game for your party. Unlike a public booking, no other customers are added to your time slot.
